title: Login button misaligned on mobile
description:
On viewports under 400px the primary **Login** button is pushed to the far right of the card instead of sitting full-width under the password field.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Open the login screen on a phone (or devtools at 375px).
2. Notice the green button is right-aligned and overflows the padding.

See the attached screenshot (login-mobile.png). Expected: the button should be full-width and left-aligned with the inputs.

comments.author: design@penglobalbd.com
comments.body: Confirmed on iPhone SE. The button container has a stray `margin-left: auto`.

title: API returns 500 on empty-cart checkout
description:
Hitting `POST /checkout` with an empty cart throws a 500 instead of a 400 validation error.

The stack trace (see error-trace.png) points at `CartService.total()` dividing by `items.length` when the cart is empty.

title: Add dark mode toggle to settings
description: Users have asked for a dark theme. Add a toggle under Settings > Appearance that persists the choice to local storage and respects `prefers-color-scheme` on first load.
